title: A worker blocker becomes attention at once, prompts the master, and after 30 unanswered minutes reaches Needs you
description: GY-3280: on a fixture install, a worker blocker on an item becomes an attention line in master status within one cycle naming the item, the blocker and how long it has waited, and delivers a prompt to the master session naming both. With no master action for 30 minutes (clock advanced), a Needs you alert appears on the dashboard naming the item and the blocker; unblocking clears both. The command step proves the loop-side behaviour on the cycle fixture; the seed, HTTP and browser steps prove the served fixture's dashboard: the aged blocker is a Needs you row and the board groups it there, the fresh one stays Blocked, and the operator's unblock from the item page clears the alert and returns the item to waiting for a worker.
